decisions.reason: The multi-model height-adjustable desk line carries substantial investment and fits the announced shift toward flexible workplaces, which post-pandemic hybrid work only reinforces, so management persists with it.
The chair family sits close to the core offer and costs little to maintain, and any softer results can be blamed on the temporary pandemic disruption of contract business, so it stays.

The high standing table supports the conference and workplace direction, and its weak office demand during 2020 to 2021 can be read as temporary, so it is kept despite being a smaller, less visible item.

The rug collection was publicly presented as a flagship of the firm's new direction, and having already justified this distant diversification, management would escalate commitment rather than admit failure.
